description: Apply an end-screen template to a video (links to a related video/playlist + a subscribe element) via the Studio end-screen editor, then save. [mutating]. End-screen editing is canvas-based and may need a manual touch-up.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab. Auto-resolved if omitted.

template.description: Which end-screen layout to apply. 'default' = first built-in template; 'last_video_subscribe' = best-for-retention; 'import' = copy from your most recent video.

name: youtube_endscreen
